column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
args.test.ts: every grammar rule and error kind with its sentence and suggestion, the help text, type inference with negative controls, random declarations written into command lines and parsed back
commands.test.ts: a tree resolved to its verb, help asked at every level, unknown words with suggestions, help rendered from the declaration
palette.test.ts: the palette's roles, marks and their ASCII fallbacks, colour only where allowed
width.test.ts: wide characters and escape sequences, a line cut by display width, never inside a grapheme or an escape sequence
vt.test.ts: the terminal emulator's sequences, scrolling, wide characters and a cut line that never wraps
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs every entry on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
ui-model.test.ts: each kind decoded, every refusal (unknown field, unknown kind, missing and mistyped field, a field of another kind) with its path
ui-caps.test.ts: the levels for a TTY, a pipe, NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, CI, a small terminal, a forced level and a Windows terminal
ui-render.test.ts: snapshots of every kind at the three levels, every line within the columns, no escape in plain, wide characters wrapped whole
ui-driver.test.ts: a question with a validation retry, a run with its result, a wait polled with a fake clock and backoff, plain waits, a time limit, an invalid step
ui-driver.test.ts: a human gate released by Enter or by the value typed, refused on input that is not a TTY, an input that ends, lines ended by CRLF, CR and LF
ui-driver.test.ts: a secret field refused before anything is written or read
ui-driver.test.ts: an abort while waiting, while asking and in full, the terminal restored and status 130
ui-screen.test.ts: the layout on the emulator of vt, no row scrolls, a resize redrawn, the fallback to ansi and back
ui-process.test.ts runs one script under Bun and under Node 26 with piped input of CRLF lines; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the packed entry
ui-render.test.ts: a UUID kept whole at 41 and 60 columns, a longer token cut, CRLF text and narrow widths

ui-resume.test.ts: the count as a position that never falls, a resumed run ticked from the first frame, [x] [>] [ ] [!], a long plan scrolled; ui-pass2.test.ts: a resume at 60x24 with done and skipped ([-]), the count kept at a step outside the plan
ui-resume.test.ts: the status line for a question, an acknowledgement, a confirmation, a verb at work and the end
ui-resume.test.ts: a 24-row screen with a long step keeps the summary on top, the prompt at the bottom and a (more marker
ui-resume.test.ts: a step given again is shown once in plain and in full, and the pane holds the current step only
ui-resume.test.ts: one transcript after the screen is left, a failure once, reported on every error; ui-pass2.test.ts: the last five steps, the failure and the closing line
ui-pass2.test.ts: the command whole beside the failure at 60x24 and 100x30 and 30 rows, the prompt wrapped to the pane, the evidence clipped first, fitPane priorities
ui-pass2.test.ts: a label as it is, the caller's short, the words that fit and ~, a first word cut with ~
ui-pass2.test.ts: the footer with the elapsed time and the dimmed last line in full on vt, the plain lines every 15 seconds, progress scrubbed to one line, the ticker ended with the work

ui-keys.test.ts: arrows, Enter, Esc, Tab, Backspace, Ctrl+C and characters from Unix and Windows sequences (CR, CRLF, SS3, scan codes), unknown sequences as errs, a chunk of several keys in order, end and abort
ui-select.test.ts: the render at plain, ansi and full, filter, wrap, scroll keeping the chosen item in view, and the numbered fallback by line
ui-widgets.test.ts: table widths, truncation with ~, header and selected row in view; the status bar; the log tail and its scroll
ui-widgets.test.ts: home at 100x30 and 60x24 on vt with the footer and the selected row protected on a short screen
ui-app.test.ts: a screen on vt redrawn on key and on resize, the value returned, abort and throw restore the terminal, not-interactive writes nothing
ui-theme.test.ts: every import of every src/ui*.ts is core, palette, width or its own file, and no source names a domain
ui-theme.test.ts: colour depth and emoji from the environment, the icon table widths (2 and 3), the theme by depth, and the left column of the flow aligned on vt with emoji and without
ui-theme.test.ts: the line mark is the emoji, else the icon's ASCII tag, else its three-column ASCII
